note: Test vectors only. The RSA key is generated for these vectors and protects nothing. Change only together with the protocol version v.
method: x25519 vectors are RFC 7748 section 6.1. HKDF: HKDF-SHA256(ikm = dh || responseKey, salt = challenge, info = "yupi-v3-ws-v1" 0x00 label 0x00 kid 0x00 audience 0x00 path, length 32). Frame: compact JWE alg dir enc A256GCM, protected header is the literal text of header, AAD is its base64url, empty encrypted key.
